```{=html}
<style>
.w132-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w132-dd .w132-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w132-dd .w132-zone {
  border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  padding: 8px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; min-height: 88px;
}
.w132-dd .w132-zone .w132-desc { font-size: 0.8rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.75; }
.w132-dd .w132-zone.w132-armed { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w132-dd .w132-zone.w132-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w132-dd .w132-zone.w132-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w132-dd .w132-pool {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: center;
  min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w132-dd .w132-chip {
  display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: grab;
  user-select: none; border: 1.5px solid #d81e2e; color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); font-weight: 600;
}
.w132-dd .w132-zone .w132-chip { margin-top: 6px; }
.w132-dd .w132-chip.w132-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w132-dd .w132-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w132-dd button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w132-dd .w132-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w132-dd .w132-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w132-dd .w132-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
</style>
<div class="w132-dd iw" id="w132-dd">
  <div class="w132-grid">
    <div class="w132-zone" data-answer="baseline">
      <div class="w132-desc">the recorded picture of normal<br>that every later detection<br>measures against (S2)</div>
    </div>
    <div class="w132-zone" data-answer="tls">
      <div class="w132-desc">confidentiality for<br>data in transit (S6)</div>
    </div>
    <div class="w132-zone" data-answer="firewall">
      <div class="w132-desc">closes the ports at the perimeter,<br>default-deny (S4)</div>
    </div>
    <div class="w132-zone" data-answer="monitoring">
      <div class="w132-desc">catches what all the preventive<br>layers let through (S9)</div>
    </div>
    <div class="w132-zone" data-answer="logging">
      <div class="w132-desc">the tamper-evident, off-host record<br>a compromise cannot erase (S10)</div>
    </div>
    <div class="w132-zone" data-answer="backup">
      <div class="w132-desc">recovers what nothing<br>prevented (S11)</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="w132-pool" aria-label="layers to place"></div>
  <div class="w132-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w132-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w132-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
  </div>
  <div class="w132-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w132-dd');
  const pool = root.querySelector('.w132-pool');
  const zones = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w132-zone')];
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w132-msg');
  const TERMS = ['Firewall', 'WAF', 'Baseline', 'Logging', 'Container', 'TLS', 'Backup', 'Monitoring'];
  let picked = null;

  function makeChip(term) {
    const c = document.createElement('span');
    c.className = 'w132-chip';
    c.textContent = term;
    c.dataset.term = term.toLowerCase();
    c.draggable = true;
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (c.parentElement !== pool) { pool.appendChild(c); unpick(); clearMarks(); return; }
      if (picked === c) { unpick(); return; }
      unpick(); picked = c; c.classList.add('w132-picked');
      zones.forEach(z => z.classList.add('w132-armed'));
    });
    c.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', term));
    return c;
  }
  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w132-picked');
    picked = null;
    zones.forEach(z => z.classList.remove('w132-armed'));
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    zones.forEach(z => z.classList.remove('w132-right', 'w132-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w132-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function place(zone, chip) {
    const old = zone.querySelector('.w132-chip');
    if (old) pool.appendChild(old);
    zone.appendChild(chip);
    clearMarks();
  }
  zones.forEach(zone => {
    zone.addEventListener('click', () => { if (picked) { place(zone, picked); unpick(); } });
    zone.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    zone.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const term = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
      const chip = root.querySelector('.w132-chip[data-term="' + term.toLowerCase() + '"]');
      if (chip) { place(zone, chip); unpick(); }
    });
  });
  pool.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  pool.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const term = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    const chip = root.querySelector('.w132-chip[data-term="' + term.toLowerCase() + '"]');
    if (chip) { pool.appendChild(chip); clearMarks(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w132-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, empty = 0;
    zones.forEach(z => {
      z.classList.remove('w132-right', 'w132-wrong');
      const chip = z.querySelector('.w132-chip');
      if (!chip) { empty++; return; }
      if (chip.dataset.term === z.dataset.answer) { z.classList.add('w132-right'); right++; }
      else { z.classList.add('w132-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === zones.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — six independent layers, each catching what the others miss.'; msg.className = 'w132-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (empty > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + empty + ' layer role(s) still unfilled.'; msg.className = 'w132-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — the red boxes hold the wrong layer (two of the eight terms belong to no box here).'; msg.className = 'w132-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w132-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w132-chip').forEach(c => pool.appendChild(c));
    unpick(); clearMarks();
  });
  TERMS.forEach(t => pool.appendChild(makeChip(t)));
})();
</script>
```
